# CLI judge-level rules (plugin). Pairs with shapes/cli.md.
version: 1.1.1

rules:
  - name: cli_output_contract
    description: |
      true when the CLI uses distinct, documented exit codes (`0` only on success),
      writes error messages to stderr, and keeps machine-readable output (e.g.
      `--json`) separate from human prose. false when the CLI conflates exit codes,
      prints errors to stdout, or mixes machine-readable output with human prose.
    relevance: the target files implement CLI output or exit-code handling

  - name: new_command_or_client_gets_its_own_project
    description: |
      true when it arrives as its own project — so `nx affected` can run it
      alone and its live-service suite stays out of reach of unrelated changes.
      false when a second command is folded into the existing CLI project as
      another entry point, or an external-system client is added inside it,
      making every change to argument parsing pay for that command's tests and
      its network calls.
    files:
      include:
        - "**/project.json"
        - "nx.json"
        - "**/pyproject.toml"
        - "**/Cargo.toml"
        - "**/package.json"
    relevance: the target files add a command the tool exposes, or a client for an external system it calls
